name: structured-artifact-viewer
description: Compact JSON, JSONL, CSV, and TSV inspection for Codex without raw dumps.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize and project structured files without wasting context.
interface.longDescription: Provides a compact local CLI and skill guidance for inspecting JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, and tool artifact files. It avoids raw cat/head/sed dumps, truncates large fields, and can install an optional repo-level hook to block unsafe raw structured file reads.
